_notes.layouts: layout is one of host_full (presenter only), host_pip (b-roll + presenter PiP) or broll_only. Missing layout falls back to broll_only. host_full scenes may omit image_url.
_notes.swap_images: Put stills in remotion/public/episodes/<topic-slug>/ as scene-1.jpg, scene-2.jpg, ... and they are picked up automatically. Otherwise Pollinations.ai generates a still per scene from its prompt, or run with --images openai to use OpenAI's image API.

scenes.text: The Fall of Rome. It began like any other story — with ambition, and with time.
At its height, its reach was measured not in miles, but in months of travel.
Then the borders thinned, and the cost of holding them rose year after year.
The end did not arrive in a single day. It arrived in a hundred small surrenders.
What survives of The Fall of Rome is stone, dust, and a warning we are still learning to read.
